scenes.text: The AI that writes *1,000* product descriptions for about *13 cents*

scenes.title: The *math*
lines: 1,000 descriptions x 150 words = about 200K tokens out.
$0.10 out plus a few cents in. Call it *13 cents*.

scenes.title: The *catch*
lines: That's the API price: you need a script or a tool built on it.
No code? The Claude app's free plan does a handful for $0.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: You still edit. Raw output sells once; edited output gets reviews.

scenes.text: Comment *SCRIPT* and I'll post the 10-line version.
